violation_type.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §746.4601(9))
violation_type.short_title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms
violation_type.typical_finding: A play structure being used by infants and toddler had a platform 29 inches off the floor and did not have a barrior that would prevent a child from falling off the platform. During the inspection, an infant age child almost fell off the platform through the opening.

finding_variants.text: A play structure being used by infants and toddler had a platform 29 inches off the floor and did not have a barrior that would prevent a child from falling off the platform. During the inspection, an infant age child almost fell off the platform through the opening.
In the two and three year old playground area the porch platform has an exposed area of twenty inches or more open allowing accessibly to children.
A platform that was more than 30 inches high did not have a protective barrier preventing the children from falling off of the structure.
A slide was removed from the composite play structure creating a four-foot drop. The operation will not use the equipment until a hard barrier is put in place or the slide is reattached.
